summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Kerala First Responders Mission 100K. 28/28 pytest cases passed covering auth, ref data, candidate registration, admin generate-test, test taking (pass & fail), certificate PDF, questions/events/orgs CRUD, reports summary & CSV export. Frontend: landing page loads, registration succeeds with success screen, admin login works with seeded creds, dashboard shows charts + KPIs, candidate list allows bulk-select + generate test (candidate becomes 'Pending'), questions page shows seeded MCQs, reports page shows Export button.

issues: Recharts emits warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render. Cosmetic; charts still render correctly on window resize. Consider setting explicit minHeight on ResponsiveContainer or removing the ResponsiveContainer aspect ambiguity.

action_items: Optional: fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer -1 width/height warnings by giving parent a defined height (e.g., min-h-[300px]).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~660 lines — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting routers (auth/candidates/tests/reports) as it grows.
In submit_test, wrong-answer keys ('Z') are accepted silently (score 0). Good behavior since correct_map.get returns None. No issue.

generate-test always returns 200 even if all candidates missing/emails failed. Consider returning 400 when total == failed and 0 sent, to surface issues. Currently returns {sent:0, failed:N} which UI can inspect.
PUBLIC_BASE_URL is used for both /test/{token} (frontend route) and /api/certificate/{token}/pdf (backend). Both resolve via ingress, so OK.
_id exclusion handled consistently via projection {'_id':0}. Good.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed candidates/questions/events/orgs; cleanup done inline via delete endpoints for CRUD tests. Candidate test data remains in DB (used by dashboard).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Full e2e candidate->generate-test->pass->certificate PDF chain verified via API. Frontend admin console fully navigable. Only cosmetic Recharts width warning noted.
